name: Edison — April 2010 TCG historical rules
masterRule: Original Master Rule era (MR1); April 2010 TCG rulings
policy: April 2010 TCG historical baseline using edisonformat.com card rulings. Sourced corrections override modern simulator behavior; later community revisions are reported separately.
